content: Canvas 2D context has a native 'direction' property (ctx.direction = 'rtl') supported across browsers since ~May 2022 that makes fillText/strokeText render Hebrew/Arabic correctly without manual string reversal; do NOT reverse the string manually as it breaks correct rendering for cursive scripts and is unnecessary for Hebrew's simple RTL glyphs. When direction is rtl, the x-coordinate passed to fillText is treated as the text's right-anchor differently -- textAlign should be set explicitly (e.g. 'right' with direction 'rtl') and width should be measured via ctx.measureText to position text precisely against the image edges.
